title: Parallel import restrictions on books
summary: The Copyright Act 1968 lets the Australian publisher of a book block commercial imports of copies published overseas, as long as it supplies the book locally within set times. The Productivity Commission recommended repealing the restrictions in 2009 and again in 2016.

instruments.title: Copyright Act 1968
instruments.provisions: importation provisions as they apply to books

direction_rationale: Blocking cheaper imported editions shields local publishers and distributors from price competition; the Productivity Commission found the restrictions raise book prices.
